Shikinaisha still missing a Kokugakuin entry id

Every real 927 register entry has an id in the Kokugakuin University Digital Museum shrine database (P13677); some entry items are missing it. The strict matcher (match_kokugakuin_ids.py) matches a shrine's Japanese name against the database's entry titles, but name-matching alone isn't safe — two adjacent entries can describe the same shrine — so it cut the missing-id set from 94 to these 18 and found zero safe to add on its own. Your call: is name-matching good enough, or do these need per-item eyes? Nothing runs until you say. Report only — no Wikidata edits.

What the statuses mean

  • NO-ANCHOR (6) — No known Kokugakuin id anywhere in this shrine's district, so there is no range to scan — the matcher had no anchor to search from.
  • NO-MATCH (7) — The district range was scanned but no entry title exactly equals this shrine's Japanese name.
  • AMBIGUOUS (2) — Another target in the same district shares this exact label, so a name match cannot tell them apart (e.g. two 野蚊神社 in 河北郡).
  • ENTRY-TAKEN (3) — A name-matching entry id exists but is already held by other item(s) — minting it here would duplicate an id. These are the ones needing per-item human eyes.
